name: LiquidGlassMaterial
material_impl: Claims token-driven Liquid Glass via liquidGlassUtils.buildLiquidGlassStyles + adaptive tint + contrast guard + clear-variant dimming (L315-397), but combinedStyles (L532-540) unconditionally overwrites `background` with a hard-coded white rgba gradient and `opacity` with 1/0.6, discarding intent backgrounds, adaptive tint, contrast tint and clear dimming. 'IOR refraction' is just saturate(1.5) vs 1.4 in a 5-way blur ternary (L339-371). Sheen is a hard-coded radial-gradient rgba (L573). Radius map hard-coded px (L432-440).
motion: Hover/press transforms via inline style + state; deviceorientation tilt listener with setState per event (L273-297); gated by useReducedMotion (L188, L400) and adds liquid-glass-reduced-motion class. Reduced-motion is actually wired. Sheen `transition` is set to an easing string only (L575) — invalid transition.
a11y: No role/tabIndex/keyboard even when interactive=true (mouse-only onMouseEnter/Down handlers L551-554); cursor-pointer on a non-focusable div. aria-disabled only. useContrastGuard computes adjustments but its opacity/tint mods are overwritten by L534-537, so contrast enforcement claim is not delivered.
api: forwardRef with merged ref; className/style passthrough; no asChild/as. Dead props destructured and never used: tint, quality, environmentAdaptation, motionResponsive (L164-167) — yet the stories ColorfulTints/QualityComparison drive exactly these. Duplicate concepts adaptToContent vs environmentAdaptation, adaptToMotion vs motionResponsive. withLiquidGlass passes material props into the wrapped component too (L623). useLiquidGlassState is a bag of useState with no behavior (L635-666). backdropSample state is set but never read (L185, L310).
ssr: 'use client'; window access only in effects; process.env.NODE_ENV in render (fine for bundlers). Backdrop + contrast guard hooks run per instance — cost scales with instance count.
fake_complexity: High. 'IOR-based refraction physics', 'environmental content awareness' and 'automatic contrast enforcement' (docblock L131-141) are not delivered visually: final background is the same hard-coded gradient regardless of intent/tint/backdrop. Tint/quality props are no-ops. Capture metadata for colorful-tints shows coloredAreaRatio 0 / meanChroma 0.21 (reports/audit/full-tint-ledger/story-doc-entries/foundations-liquid-glass-primitives-liquid-glass-material--colorful-tints/desktop.json), consistent with tints never rendering.
duplicates: OptimizedGlassCore/OptimizedGlass, GlassCore, GlassAdvanced, OptimizedGlassAdvanced, components/advanced/LiquidGlassGPU, core/mixins createGlassStyle — at least 6 parallel 'glass surface' primitives with different prop vocabularies.
target: Single canonical material primitive (merge with OptimizedGlassCore/GlassCore into one LiquidGlass surface with real token-driven background)
justification: This is the name the library sells as its Apple Liquid Glass core, and it is the right place for a flagship primitive, but the implementation contradicts itself: ~250 lines compute intent/tint/contrast/dimming backgrounds that are thrown away by a hard-coded override at L532-540, four public props are dead, interactive mode is mouse-only, and 'IOR' is a saturate() tweak. It must be rebuilt as the one material engine (token background layers, real specular/edge highlight, contrast-guarded text, keyboard-capable interactive mode) with every other surface primitive consolidated onto it. Keep the API surface small and remove the dead props.

name: GlassCore (aliases Glass, GlassBase, GlassPrimitive)
material_impl: Shared: createGlassStyle({intent,elevation,tier,...}) from src/core/mixins/glassMixins.ts:41 plus glass-foundation-basic class. Radius is a hard-coded px ternary chain (L73-88) instead of radius tokens.
motion: None in component; hoverLift/press only toggle CSS classes (glass-state-hoverable/pressable) — reduced-motion depends on global CSS.
a11y: interactive=true adds classes but no role/tabIndex/keyboard; focusRing flag is opt-in so focus visibility is not default.
api: forwardRef, className/style passthrough, intent/elevation/tier vocabulary (matches tokens). No as/asChild. Exported under 4 names (Glass, GlassBase, GlassPrimitive, GlassCore) — alias sprawl. Legacy GlassVariant/BlurIntensity types kept.
fake_complexity: None; it is honest and small.
duplicates: OptimizedGlassCore, GlassAdvanced, OptimizedGlassAdvanced, LiquidGlassMaterial; createGlassStyle direct use in many components.
target: Canonical LiquidGlass surface primitive (redesigned LiquidGlassMaterial / OptimizedGlassCore)
justification: The cleanest of the surface primitives in this shard: token-driven via createGlassStyle, small, SSR-safe. But it is one of six overlapping surfaces with four export aliases, hard-coded radius px, and interactive mode without keyboard semantics. Fold it into the single canonical surface as its static/low-tier path and keep only one public name.

name: GlassAdvanced
material_impl: Hybrid: class stack (glass-foundation-complete, glass-elev-N, glass-blur-*, glass-overlay-noise/specular, glass-edge, glass-glow-*) PLUS inline createGlassStyle; renders glass-layer-frost + glass-layer-ink children (L248-249). Two styling systems applied simultaneously so class-level blur/variant may be overridden by inline createGlassStyle.
motion: motion presets as CSS classes, gated by useReducedMotion (L136, L178). Wired.
a11y: Best in shard among surfaces: auto role=button + tabIndex + Enter/Space for clickable divs (L139-158), glass-focus and glass-touch-target on interactive. Gaps: contrast='on' behaves same as 'off' (only 'auto' adds a class, L184); disabled+interactive stays tabbable.
api: forwardRef + `as` polymorphism (untyped React.ElementType, props cast to any L246-247). Vocabulary elev 0-6 / variant default|primary|... / blur sm..xl differs from GlassCore (intent/elevation levelN) and OptimizedGlassAdvanced (elevation levelN/blur subtle..intense). Prop interface is named GlassProps, colliding with GlassCore's GlassProps type. composeGlassClasses helper unused outside.
fake_complexity: Low; features map to real CSS classes, though 'contrast' prop is mostly cosmetic.
justification: Has the most complete interactive a11y handling of the surface primitives and real layer structure (frost/ink), which is worth harvesting, but it duplicates GlassCore/OptimizedGlass with a third prop vocabulary, double-applies class and inline material, and has auto-generated 2-story docs. Merge its a11y and overlay-layer logic into the canonical surface and retire the name.

name: OptimizedGlassAdvanced
material_impl: Bespoke: hard-coded inline background gradient, rgba border and box-shadow (L362-375) override everything. BLUR_CLASSES maps all four blur levels to the same class glass-backdrop-blur (L104-110), which reads --glass-blur-md not the --glass-blur set by PERFORMANCE_STYLES (src/styles/glass.css:147) — so both blur and performanceMode blur are no-ops. VARIANT_CLASSES are all 'bg-transparent border-0' (L112-125), so 12 variants including holographic/neural/ethereal render identically. activeGlow uses Tailwind ring-blue-400/20 (hard-coded palette).
motion: Own matchMedia reduced-motion implementation (duplicates useReducedMotion) gating animation/micro-interaction classes; but GLASS_BASE_CLASSES.interactive hover:scale/active:scale is NOT gated (L90, L298-299). cursorHighlight does setState on every mousemove (L396-402) — re-render per pointer move. will-change-transform on every instance (L91).
a11y: interactive only adds classes (glass-focus, glass-touch-target); no role/tabIndex/keyboard.
api: forwardRef, className/style; ~30 props, most cosmetic flags; 'lazyEffects' setTimeout 100ms toggles a few shadow classes; useGlassPerformance hook here is a stub and is shadowed by a different useGlassPerformance exported from hooks/extended (src/index.ts:944). OptimizedGlassProps type name collides with OptimizedGlassCore's.
fake_complexity: High. '70% performance improvement' docblock (L210-219) is unsubstantiated and per-mousemove setState plus universal will-change contradicts it; variants holographic/neural/ethereal/crystal, lighting 'caustic/volumetric', blur levels and performanceMode blur do nothing distinct.
duplicates: OptimizedGlassCore (same 'Optimized' concept), GlassAdvanced, GlassCore, LiquidGlassMaterial. Used internally by GlassSearchInterface and GlassErrorBoundary.
justification: A prop-explosion surface where most props are no-ops: every blur level maps to one class, all 12 variants share one class, and the inline hard-coded gradient overrides the rest. Its performance claims are contradicted by its own code. Deprecate with a codemod to the canonical surface; migrate the two internal consumers.

name: LiquidGlassBackdropSampler
material_impl: Wraps useLiquidGlassBackdrop hook; paints a hard-coded inset white box-shadow (L42) on what should be an invisible measurement wrapper.
a11y: Neutral wrapper; but all HTML attributes (id, aria-*, role, onClick, data-*) are swallowed into the hook `options` rest (L22,25) and never reach the div — consumers cannot label or test it.
api: forwardRef via useImperativeHandle; render-prop children; onSample. Rest-spread bug: `...options` mixes DOM props into hook options.
fake_complexity: Depends on hook (not in shard); component itself honest.
duplicates: useLiquidGlassBackdrop hook, utils/contrastGuard useContrastGuard sampling, components with own backdrop sampling.
justification: Useful render-prop exposure of backdrop sampling, but it decorates itself with a hard-coded shadow and drops all DOM props into hook options. Split DOM props from hook options, remove the visual styling, and document it as a headless utility.

name: LiquidGlassConcentricFrame
material_impl: Correct concentric radius math (outer - inset with floor) using --glass-radius-* tokens (L20-56). But always paints a hard-coded inset rgba box-shadow (L91) and sets text color — a geometry helper should not paint.
api: forwardRef, className/style, asChild via cloneElement (overrides child ref, does not merge it, L95-109). Inconsistent defaults: fallbackRadius default 8 in component vs 12 in helper (L46 vs L67).
ssr: SSR-safe, no client APIs (does not need 'use client').
fake_complexity: None — genuinely implements concentric radii, a real Apple HIG concept.
duplicates: Slot asChild (src/primitives/Slot.tsx) should be reused instead of bespoke cloneElement.
justification: A real, valuable design-system primitive (concentric corner radii) with sound math. Remove the baked-in shadow/color, reuse Slot for asChild with ref merging, unify fallback defaults, and give it a proper visual story showing nested radii.

name: LiquidGlassEffectGroup
material_impl: Context + data attributes only. 'samplingStrategy: shared' and 'spacing' are published to context/CSS var but nothing consumes them for shared sampling or merging; CSS only adds isolation and transitions to direct children (src/styles/glass.css:4439-4454).
motion: morph=true only adds transition on direct material children; reduced-motion gated via useReducedMotion and CSS media query (glass.css:4571-4576).
api: forwardRef, className/style; groupId from props.id ?? useId (good).
fake_complexity: Medium: named after Apple GlassEffectContainer (merging/morphing glass shapes) but performs no shape merging, shared backdrop sampling or spacing-based blending.
justification: The concept (group glass shapes so they share sampling and morph together) is exactly what a premium Liquid Glass system needs and is a flagship differentiator, but today it is a context with data attributes and a transition rule. Either implement real shared material (single backdrop layer, SVG/CSS merge within spacing) or rename to what it is.

name: LiquidGlassLayerProvider / LiquidGlassSurfaceLayer
material_impl: Non-visual context tracking depth/insideGlass/variant/performance/contrastPolicy. Only consumer effect found: LiquidGlassMaterial adds 'liquid-glass-layered-surface' class (LiquidGlassMaterial.tsx:525); allowNestedGlass and contrastPolicy are never enforced.
motion: Calls useReducedMotion in every provider and every surface layer (one matchMedia subscription per glass surface).
api: Plain components (no DOM). Good nesting semantics (depth++).

name: LiquidGlassScrollEdge
material_impl: createGlassStyle for the edge, then overrides background with hard-coded rgba white gradients behind CSS vars (L139-142). No dark-mode / tint awareness; a white veil on light content is invisible and on dark content looks like fog.
motion: CSS opacity transition via var; no reduced-motion need beyond that.
api: forwardRef; overloaded: overlay-only vs container mode decided implicitly by `children !== undefined` (L71) — surprising; className/style route to edge or container depending on mode.
ssr: SSR-safe; scroll/resize listeners passive. No ResizeObserver, so edge state is stale when content height changes without scroll.
duplicates: Scroll-shadow logic inside GlassScrollArea / list components (likely bespoke).
justification: Honest, useful primitive mirroring Apple's scroll edge effect. Needs theme-aware edge materials (tokenized, dark/light), a ResizeObserver, explicit mode prop instead of children sniffing, and a real story with scrollable content.

name: LiquidGlassTransitionProvider / LiquidGlassSource / LiquidGlassDestination (alias LiquidGlassSourceTransition)
motion: Not a real shared-element (FLIP/View Transitions) morph: destination only gets a class that plays a generic 'liquid-glass-source-pop' keyframe (glass.css:4464-4468). transformOrigin is set to the source's viewport coordinates (L148) but transform-origin is relative to the destination's own box, so the origin is wrong whenever the destination is not at viewport 0,0. getBoundingClientRect read during render (L147). activeId never auto-clears. Declared props namespace and duration are unused (L27-29, L32-35). Reduced motion respected.
a11y: LiquidGlassSource renders a clickable div with onClick and no role/tabIndex/keyboard (L111-121) unless asChild with a button.
api: forwardRef; asChild via cloneElement that drops child's own onClick (overrides) and ref; ignores ...props in asChild branch (L97-108).
fake_complexity: High relative to name: promises source-to-destination glass morph, delivers a pop animation with miscomputed origin.
justification: Source-anchored morphing sheets/menus are a signature Liquid Glass behavior and a legitimate flagship, but this implementation is a class toggle with an incorrect transform-origin, unused props, and a keyboard-inaccessible default source. Rebuild on FLIP (measure source/destination rects in layout effect, animate transform+radius) with View Transitions API progressive enhancement and a button-based Source.

name: DismissableLayer (alias GlassDismissableLayer)
a11y: Escape/outside pointer/outside focus dismissal with preventDefault-able callbacks — solid Radix-like contract. No layer stack: nested layers all dismiss on a single Escape (each registers its own document keydown and none stops propagation); a click inside a nested portal-rendered child layer counts as outside for the parent. disableOutsidePointerEvents sets body pointer-events:none with no stacking, so two layers restore in wrong order.
api: forwardRef with ref merge, HTMLAttributes passthrough. Effect deps on inline callbacks re-subscribe every render (harmless but churny). `style` placed before {...props} fine.
duplicates: Outside-click/escape logic re-implemented in GlassModal, GlassPopover, GlassDropdownMenu, hooks (useClickOutside), FocusTrap onEscape.
justification: A correct, small headless primitive that should be the single dismissal engine for all overlays. Needs a layer stack (only top-most layer handles Escape/outside), portal-aware 'inside' detection, and adoption by Modal/Popover/Dropdown to remove duplicated logic.

name: FocusScope (alias GlassFocusScope)
a11y: Trap + loop + autofocus + restore focus. Bug: with loop=true and trapped=false, the document-level Tab handler pulls focus into the scope from anywhere on the page when activeElement is outside (L113-125), hijacking global tab order. focusin preventDefault is a no-op (focusin is not cancelable, L133). No scope stack for nested scopes.
duplicates: FocusTrap (same shard) + useFocusTrap, utils/a11yEnhancers FocusTrap, utils/focus.ts, hooks/extended/useGlassFocus setupFocusTrap — at least 4 focus-trap implementations.
target: Canonical focus-trap; absorb FocusTrap, a11yEnhancers FocusTrap, useGlassFocus trap
justification: This is the better-designed of the focus primitives (forwardRef, cancelable mount/unmount events, used by GlassMenuPrimitive/DropdownMenu/SelectCompound) and should be the single canonical trap. Fix loop-without-trap hijacking, add a scope stack, then migrate the other trap implementations onto it.

name: FocusTrap (+ useFocusTrap)
stories: src/primitives/focus/FocusTrap.stories.tsx (2 empty auto-generated stories: 'A glass morphism focustrap component.')
a11y: Serious bug: default `exclude = []` (L65) creates a new array each render, so getFocusableElements/focusFirst/handleTabKey identities change every render; the main effect (L211-253) therefore tears down and re-runs on every parent re-render — cleanup restores focus to the pre-trap element and setup re-captures it and autofocuses the first element after 0ms. Inline onEscape (used at GlassHeader.tsx:1131, GlassSearchInterface.tsx:507) has the same effect. Any state update in the parent yanks focus to the first focusable. In GlassSearchInterface the trap wraps only the results list (L507-511), so the focusin guard (L256-276) also pulls focus away from the search input outside it. When exclude is non-empty, the visibility filter is skipped entirely (L83-87). 'details' in selector duplicates summary targets. Sentinels are aria-hidden yet tabbable.
api: Not forwardRef, no className/style, wrapper div unstyled; useFocusTrap hook duplicates the entire logic with slightly different semantics (no outside-focus wrap on Tab).
duplicates: FocusScope (canonical), utils/a11yEnhancers.tsx:179 FocusTrap, hooks/extended/useGlassFocus setupFocusTrap, utils/focus.ts.
justification: Internal but load-bearing: GlassSelect, GlassPopover, GlassHeader, GlassMobileNav and GlassSearchInterface all depend on it, and its unstable-dependency effect causes focus to jump on every parent re-render. Replace all call sites with FocusScope (trapped, loop, restoreFocus) and delete this file and its placeholder stories.

name: SkipLinks (+ MainContent, Navigation, SearchLandmark, useSkipLinks)
material_impl: Focused skip link uses Tailwind bg-primary/text-primary-foreground/ring-primary (shadcn-style tokens not AuraGlass glass tokens) mixed with glass-focus/glass-contrast-guard classes.

Issues: redundant roles (main role=main, nav role=navigation, search role=search), Navigation/MainContent hard-code aria-label overriding page structure; default links point to #main-navigation/#search which may not exist.

justification: Functionally decent skip links, but there are three separate SkipLinks implementations and this one is not even exported. Pick one, style it with glass tokens, respect reduced motion for scroll, and export it publicly.

name: ScreenReader family (ScreenReader, ScreenReaderOnly, LiveRegion, announce, useAnnounce, DescribedBy, LabelledBy, LoadingAnnouncement, ValidationAnnouncement)
material_impl: None; mixes `sr-only` (Tailwind) and `glass-sr-only` classes inconsistently (L69, L204, L267).
a11y: Multiple defects: DescribedBy/LabelledBy generate Math.random ids during render (L259-260, L287) -> new id every render and SSR hydration mismatch (should be useId). LiveRegion uses role='region' with no accessible name (L121) — wrong role for a live region. useAnnounce returns a new `announce` function each render, so LoadingAnnouncement/ValidationAnnouncement effects (deps include announce, L327-334, L358) re-announce on every parent re-render; ValidationAnnouncement also re-fires whenever a new errors array instance is passed. Live region nodes are created on mount and immediately written to, which many screen readers skip.
api: Plain functions, no forwardRef; ScreenReaderOnly supports `as`.
ssr: Math.random ids break hydration; announce() guards document.
duplicates: components/accessibility/GlassA11y GlassScreenReader (root-exported), utils/a11yEnhancers.tsx:573 LiveRegion, utils/a11y.ts announce helpers.
target: One public a11y module (VisuallyHidden + LiveAnnouncer provider) in components/accessibility; merge GlassScreenReader and a11yEnhancers LiveRegion
justification: Unexported duplicate of announcement utilities that exist in at least two other places, with hydration-unsafe ids, a mis-roled live region and re-announcement loops. Consolidate into one VisuallyHidden + single persistent LiveAnnouncer provider using useId.
